maintenance_led.reason: Sells new implants, aligners, orthodontic products, equipment and consumables to dental practices, not mainly repair or aftermarket servicing.

publicly_funded.reason: Dental professionals and patients pay privately or through commercial insurance; customers are dental practices and labs.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its dental brands' products and innovation, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Implant systems and digital workflows need clinician training and compatible components, so switching is costly. Consumables are easier to switch.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgement call, because the Equipment & Consumables segment has easier switching.
